module test_counter #(
    // Parameter for future width extension (currently fixed at 8 bits)
    parameter int CNT_W = 8
) (
    // Clock and control inputs
    input  logic               clk,
    input  logic               rst_n,   // asynchronous active‑low reset
    input  logic               en,      // count enable

    // Parallel count output
    output logic [CNT_W-1:0]     cnt,

    // Optional busy status output (high when counting)
    output logic               busy
);

// -------------------------------------------------------------
//  Type Definitions
// -------------------------------------------------------------
typedef enum logic [1:0] {
    IDLE,
    CNT_EN,
    ERROR
} state_t;

// -------------------------------------------------------------
//  Registers
// -------------------------------------------------------------
state_t  state_reg;      // Current FSM state
logic [CNT_W-1:0] cnt_reg; // Current counter value
logic                 en_ff;     // Synchronized enable
logic [CNT_W:0]       cnt_next;  // Next count (adds 1, one extra bit for overflow)
logic                 busy_int;  // Intermediate busy signal

// -------------------------------------------------------------
//  State Register (synchronous)
// -------------------------------------------------------------
always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        state_reg  <= IDLE;
        cnt_reg    <= '0;
        en_ff      <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        en_ff      <= en;
        state_reg  <= state_next;
        // cnt_reg is updated with the registered next value below
    end
end

// -------------------------------------------------------------
//  Next‑State Computation (combinational)
// -------------------------------------------------------------
always_comb begin
    // Default next state is unchanged
    state_next = state_reg;

    // State transition logic
    case (state_reg)
        IDLE: begin
            if (en && rst_n) state_next = CNT_EN;
        end
        CNT_EN: begin
            if (!en) state_next = IDLE;
        end
        ERROR: state_next = IDLE; // safety net
    endcase
end

// -------------------------------------------------------------
//  Next‑Count Computation (combinational)
// -------------------------------------------------------------
always_comb begin
    // Increment by one, truncate to CNT_W bits (wrap‑around on overflow)
    cnt_next = {1'b0, cnt_reg} + 8'd1; // 9‑bit addition, result fits in cnt_next
end

// -------------------------------------------------------------
//  Busy Flag (combinational)
// -------------------------------------------------------------
always_comb begin
    // Busy when enable is asserted and reset is not active
    busy_int = en && rst_n;
end

// -------------------------------------------------------------
//  Counter Register Update (synchronous)
// -------------------------------------------------------------
always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        cnt_reg <= '0;
    end else begin
        cnt_reg <= cnt_next[CNT_W-1:0]; // Retain only the lower CNT_W bits
    end
end

// -------------------------------------------------------------
//  Port Assignments
// -------------------------------------------------------------
assign cnt   = cnt_reg;
assign busy  = busy_int;

endmodule
